title: Diffusion-Based Auctions for Multi-Winner Banner Ads
abstract: arXiv:2610.14473v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose a new framework for banner ad auctions, leveraging diffusion models to allow for multiple bidders to co-win a single banner ad opportunity, and in particular influence the ad shown on the banner depending on the strength of their bids, enabling a far richer outcome space compared to standard banner ad auctions, where there is a single winner who shows their ad. In our framework, the outcomes are images (what ad to show) and each bidder expresses their preferences over outcomes by declaring their value per unit of alignment between the image chosen by the mechanism and a textual description of their desired image. Our proposed mechanism combines the advertisers' bids and textual descriptions into a score that drives the reverse process of a diffusion model. This is used to sample a set of candidate images from which the welfare maximizing one is eventually chosen. Extensive experimentation evaluates our proposed mechanism aro

translated_title: 基于扩散模型的多赢家横幅广告拍卖
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种新的横幅广告拍卖框架，利用扩散模型允许多个投标者共同赢得单个横幅广告机会，并且特别是根据他们出价的强弱来影响横幅上展示的广告，与标准横幅广告拍卖（其中只有一个赢家展示其广告）相比，这实现了更为丰富的结果空间。在我们的框架中，结果是图像（即展示什么广告），每个投标者通过声明机制所选择图像与其期望图像文本描述之间每单位一致性的价值，来表达他们对结果的偏好。我们提出的机制将广告主的出价和文本描述组合成一个分数，该分数驱动扩散模型的逆过程，用于采样一组候选图像，并从中最终选出福利最大化的图像。大量实验评估了我们提出的机制在各方面的表现。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于扩散模型的横幅广告拍卖新框架，允许多个广告主根据出价强度共同影响单个广告位的展示内容，通过将出价与文本描述融合驱动扩散模型生成候选广告图像，最终选出福利最大化的结果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a diffusion-model-based auction framework for banner ads that enables multiple bidders to co-win a single ad opportunity, using bids and textual descriptions to drive the diffusion process and select the welfare-maximizing ad image.
